name: Projected Distinguishing Range / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm R^p(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{RTD}^p(\mathcal H)$.
proof: For every coordinate projection $\mathcal G=\mathcal H_{|S}$, a distinguishing coordinate set of size $\mathrm R(\mathcal G)$ is a teaching set for every concept of $\mathcal G$.  Hence $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal G)\leq\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal G)\leq\mathrm R(\mathcal G)$.  Taking the maximum over all projections gives $\mathrm{RTD}^p(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm R^p(\mathcal H)$.
witness_verification: For half-intervals, projected distinguishing range is $n-1$, while projected recursive teaching dimension is $1$.
